grc:noun:ἀρβύλη.html:
ἀρβύλη [υ], <γεν λανγ͂"γρεεκ" οπτ͂"ν" τειφορμ͂"γεν">ἡ<γ́εν>,
strong shoe coming up to the ankle, half-boot, used by country people, hunters, travellers, , , (lyr.); πηλοπατίδες ἀ.; αὐταῖσιν ἀρβύλαισιν ἁρμόσας πόδαwith shoes and all, (wrongly expld. by as =δίφρος, the stand of the charioteer), cf. ; cf. ἄρμυλα.

grc:noun:ἄρβηλος.html:
ἄρβηλος, ὁ (Sch. l.c.),
semicircular knife, used by cobblers, i.e. leather-workers (ἄρβηλοι γὰρ τὰ δέρματαs.v.ἀνάρβηλα), .
Geom., figure resembling it in shape, contained by three semicircles with coincident diameters <*>, .

grc:name:Ἄρβηλα.gloss: Arbela (an ancient city in Mesopotamia, in modern Iraq; modern Arbil)

grc:name:Ἀρβάκης.gloss: a male given name, Arbaces, from Old Median
